answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots; every applicant bids a bond. Reserve: 60 POA, twice one identity's monthly earnings, locked 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 wins, costing 60,000 POA for a 30,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. Bids flow through an inlet; a bidder proved fake forfeits its bond to burning. An honest agent pays once, keeps its island, earns the bond back, while the reserve stays a knoll too steep for copies.
